name: picker
description: THE PICKER'S THEME (2026-10-04; the chrome round, the flags round, the playhead round, the label round, the open-flag round, the invalid-flags round, then the flag kinds' round of 2026-10-05): themes/warptempo.json with the chrome as ONE KNOB, its ground #191919 under the chrome rule (`chrome`: Windows 95's proportions, every relief line, the field and the emboss's light copy following the ground; at #191919 the theme warptempo's own row), the canvas #0E0E0E, the ink #A6B9DE (the ink round's latest pick), the outline by its rule ("auto": the 50 % linear-light blend of the ink over the canvas), EACH FLAG KIND'S FACE AND SELECTED FACE (architect 2026-10-05: the picker's flag elements follow the product's flag kinds, keyed by its role names so a preset maps one to one; render.h's flag palette block): the warp pair #666699 / #9999CC (`flag_fill` / `flag_fill_sel`, the current design for now, CE01), the phase-reset pair the same (`flag_fill_reset` / `flag_fill_reset_sel`; one flag pair showed for every authored kind until this round), the history's added pair #808000 / #008000 (`flag_fill_added` / `flag_fill_added_sel`, the built-in's) and its removed pair #993333 / #FF6666 (`flag_fill_red` / `flag_fill_red_sel`, the invalid-flags round's colours: the invalid flag wears the removed pair), BOTH FLAG LABELS WHITE (architect 2026-10-04: consistency; `flag_label` and `flag_label_sel` #FFFFFF, the product's one label pair for every kind; program keys of their own, fixed), the selected pair, the selected fill #666666 under the selected text #FFFFFF (the open-flag round's elements), the chrome's label #FFFFFF with the field text following it (`@label`: the field ground is the Hilight, a ground-family colour, so its text is the label's case). Exported with --export for tools/palette/picker/: sixteen elements in the architect's order of importance, Chrome (active), Canvas and Ink over the scene `waveform` (the ink round's: the marker stems, the flags, the playhead and row 8's state line switched off); then the flag kinds, each element its face and its stem: Warp Flag and Selected Warp Flag over the scene `flags` (the waveform scene with the stems and the warp column's flags on, the fourth flag from the left SELECTED with its payload box the addressed cell, so its stem is bright: the state he meets a selected flag in most); Phase Reset Flag and Selected Phase Reset Flag over the scene `phase_reset` (the flags scene as the phase-reset column, flags.lane "phase_reset": every flag the phase-reset pair labelled the lane token `reset`, the fourth selected as the flags scene selects it, the target + P view's button down; the lead-in ring is not drawn); Added Flag, Selected Added Flag, Removed Flag and Selected Removed Flag over the scene `history` (the `h` view's diff lane, flags.lane "history": `[+]1.27+0.00:b.33`, `[-]b.33`, `[+]b.33`, the changed pair `[-]b.33` | `[+]1.25` that is the view's focus -- both halves their selected faces under the selected label, its stem the removed half's -- and `[-]b.33` clipped at the edge; the History button down). Then Playhead Head and Playhead Stem (architect 2026-10-04: the program's two playhead keys, #8B8B8B and #FCFCFC, the product's defaults) over the scene `playhead` (the flags scene's stems and flags with NO flag selected -- in the app a marker click lands the playhead on it, and a playhead standing on a marker suppresses its own stem -- and the playhead ON at its column, x 293: the head opaque in the tablet geometry, its one-LW outline the label, the stem uniform down the marker lane and the well). Then Label (architect 2026-10-04: the chrome's TEXT colour, a pickable element -- not a black / white switch and not automatic contrast -- starting #FFFFFF; every role the label roots follows it: the menu words, the legend, the clock, the ruler's timestamps, the icons' text ink, the scroll arrow, the playhead head's outline, the state line) over the scene `label` (the waveform scene with row 8's state line ON, the app's label-coloured process line, so the most chrome text shows; the flags stay off, their labels being program keys of their own). Then Selection and Selected Text (architect 2026-10-04: the theme's selected pair, Windows' Hilight / HilightText, starting at #666666 and #FFFFFF) over the scene `open_flag` (the flags scene's stems and flags with the fourth flag's EDITOR OPEN and its whole text selected, as the editor opens: the face the selected warp face, the black frame, the band the selection under the selected text, the stem the selected face; the fourth flag, x 1816, stays in view right of the panel and its theme strip when the panel opens on the left). The flag labels and the flag outlines stay fixed roles.
